display.purpose: Titles and the logo. Sentence case, no outline: white on blue, ink on ivory and green.

button.purpose: Button labels in ink on green or ivory.

body.purpose: Service copy, help text and prices.

shadows.name: ink-drop
shadows.purpose: Small cartoon depth under buttons, nodes, windows and cards.

shadows.name: button-lip
shadows.purpose: Lower lip on the pressable button (green or ivory).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button press and release, no overshoot.

motion.name: tile-tempo
motion.purpose: Fixed falling tempo: path length = time.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: The phone showcase stacks into a column (1000px on the themes page).

themes.rule: Themes change tokens, canvas palette and copy tone only; never rules, levels, prices or progress.

narrative.northStar: Dominó Pop (v2, quieter) as default, plus ten selectable themes
rules: One primary action per screen, in green.
Only two button kinds: green primary and ivory secondary.
Yellow = falling or won, never spending money.
Options of equal size in decision popups.
Every popup shows the real screen underneath.
